verses.en: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.
verses.pt: Ora, o rei Davi era já velho, de idade mui avançada; e por mais que o cobrissem de roupas não se aquecia.
verses.en_web: Now king David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he couldn’t keep warm.
verses.en_bbe: Now King David was old and far on in years; and though they put covers over him, his body was cold.

verses.en: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.
verses.pt: Disseram-lhe, pois, os seus servos: Busque-se para o rei meu senhor uma jovem donzela, que esteja perante o rei, e tenha cuidado dele; e durma no seu seio, para que o rei meu senhor se aqueça.
verses.en_web: Therefore his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king, and cherish him; and let her lie in your bosom, that my lord the king may keep warm.”
verses.en_bbe: So his servants said to him, Let search be made for a young virgin for my lord the king, to take care of him and be waiting on him; and you may take her in your arms, and so my lord the king will be warm.

verses.en: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.pt: Assim buscaram por todos os termos de Israel uma jovem formosa; e acharam Abisague, a sunamita, e a trouxeram ao rei.
verses.en_web: So they sought for a beautiful young lady throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.en_bbe: So after searching through all the land of Israel for a fair young girl, they saw Abishag the Shunammite, and took her to the king.

verses.en: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.
verses.pt: Era a jovem sobremaneira formosa; e cuidava do rei, e o servia; porém o rei não a conheceu.
verses.en_web: The young lady was very beautiful; and she cherished the king, and served him; but the king didn’t know her intimately.
verses.en_bbe: Now she was very beautiful; and she took care of the king, waiting on him at all times; but the king had no connection with her.

verses.en: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.pt: Então Adonias, filho de Hagite, se exaltou e disse: Eu reinarei. E preparou para si carros e cavaleiros, e cinqüenta homens que corressem adiante dele.
verses.en_web: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, “I will be king.” Then he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.en_bbe: Then Adonijah, the son of Haggith, lifting himself up in pride, said, I will become king; and he made ready his carriages of war and his horsemen, with fifty runners to go before him.

verses.en: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.
verses.pt: Ora, nunca seu pai o tinha contrariado, dizendo: Por que fizeste assim? Além disso, era ele muito formoso de parecer; e era mais moço do que Absalão.
verses.en_web: His father had not displeased him at any time in saying, “Why have you done so?” and he was also a very handsome man; and he was born after Absalom.
verses.en_bbe: Now all his life his father had never gone against him or said to him, Why have you done so? and he was a very good-looking man, and younger than Absalom.

verses.en: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.
verses.pt: E teve entendimento com Joabe, filho de Zeruia, e com o sacerdote Abiatar, os quais aderiram a ele e o ajudavam.
verses.en_web: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest; and they followed Adonijah and helped him.
verses.en_bbe: And he had talk with Joab, the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest; and they were on his side and gave him their support.

verses.en: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
verses.pt: Mas Zadoque, o sacerdote, e Benaías, filho de Jeoiada, e Natã, o profeta, e Simei, e Rei, e os valentes que Davi tinha, não eram por Adonias.
verses.en_web: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
verses.en_bbe: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet and Shimei and Rei, and David's men of war did not take the side of Adonijah.

verses.en: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by En-rogel, and called all his brethren the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah the king’s servants:
verses.pt: Adonias matou ovelhas, bois e animais cevados, junto à pedra de Zoelete, que está perto de En-Rogel; e convidou a todos os seus irmãos, os filhos do rei, e a todos os homens de Judá, servos do rei;
verses.en_web: Adonijah killed sheep, cattle, and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En Rogel; and he called all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah, the king’s servants;
verses.en_bbe: Then Adonijah put to death sheep and oxen and fat beasts by the stone of Zoheleth, by En-rogel; and he sent for all his brothers, the king's sons, and all the men of Judah, the king's servants, to come to him:

verses.en: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.
verses.pt: porém a Natã, o profeta, e a Benaías, e aos valentes, e a Salomão, seu irmão, não os convidou.
verses.en_web: but he didn’t call Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother.
verses.en_bbe: But he did not send for Nathan the prophet and Benaiah and the other men of war and Solomon his brother.

verses.en: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?
verses.pt: Então falou Natã a Bate-Seba, mãe de Salomão, dizendo: Não ouviste que Adonias, filho de Hagite, reina? e que nosso senhor Davi não o sabe?
verses.en_web: Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, “Haven’t you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith reigns, and David our lord doesn’t know it?
verses.en_bbe: Then Nathan said to Bath-sheba, the mother of Solomon, Has it not come to your ears that Adonijah, the son of Haggith, has made himself king without the knowledge of David our lord?

verses.en: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.
verses.pt: Vem, pois, agora e deixa-me dar-te um conselho, para que salves a tua vida, e a de teu filho Salomão.
verses.en_web: Now therefore come, please let me give you counsel, that you may save your own life, and your son Solomon’s life.
verses.en_bbe: So now, let me make a suggestion, so that you may keep your life safe and the life of your son Solomon.

verses.en: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?
verses.pt: Vai à presença do rei Davi, e dize-lhe: Não juraste, ó rei meu senhor, à tua serva, dizendo: Certamente teu filho Salomão reinará depois de mim, e se assentará no meu trono? Por que, pois, reina Adonias?
verses.en_web: Go in to king David, and tell him, ‘Didn’t you, my lord, king, swear to your servant, saying, “Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne?” Why then does Adonijah reign?’
verses.en_bbe: Come now, go to King David and say to him, Did you not, O my lord, take an oath to me, your servant, saying, Truly Solomon your son will be king after me, seated on the seat of my kingdom? why then is Adonijah acting as king?

verses.en: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.
verses.pt: Eis que, estando tu ainda a falar com o rei, eu também entrarei depois de ti, e confirmarei as tuas palavras.
verses.en_web: Behold, while you are still talking there with the king, I will also come in after you and confirm your words.”
verses.en_bbe: And while you are still talking there with the king, see, I will come in after you and say that your story is true.

verses.en: And Bath-sheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.
verses.pt: Foi, pois, Bate-Seba à presença do rei na sua câmara. Ele era mui velho; e Abisague, a sunamita, o servia.
verses.en_web: Bathsheba went in to the king in his room. The king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.
verses.en_bbe: Then Bath-sheba went into the king's room; now the king was very old, and Abishag the Shunammite was waiting on him.

verses.en: And Bath-sheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?
verses.pt: Bate-Seba inclinou a cabeça, e se prostrou perante o rei. Então o rei lhe perguntou: Que queres?
verses.en_web: Bathsheba bowed, and showed respect to the king. The king said, “What would you like?”
verses.en_bbe: And Bath-sheba went down on her face on the earth before the king giving him honour. And he said, What is your desire?

verses.en: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the LORD thy God unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe ela: Senhor meu, tu juraste à tua serva pelo Senhor teu Deus, dizendo: Salomão, teu filho, reinará depois de mim, e se assentará no meu trono.
verses.en_web: She said to him, “My lord, you swore by Yahweh your God to your servant, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne.’
verses.en_bbe: And she said to him, My lord, you took an oath by the Lord your God and gave your word to your servant, saying, Truly, Solomon your son will be king after me, seated on the seat of my kingdom.

verses.en: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest it not:
verses.pt: E agora eis que Adonias reina; e tu, ó rei meu senhor, não o sabes.
verses.en_web: Now, behold, Adonijah reigns; and you, my lord the king, don’t know it.
verses.en_bbe: And now, see, Adonijah has made himself king without my lord's knowledge;

verses.en: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.
verses.pt: Ele matou bois, animais cevados e ovelhas em abundância, e convidou a todos os filhos do rei, e a Abiatar, o sacerdote, e a Joabe, general do exército; mas a teu servo Salomão não o convidou.
verses.en_web: He has slain cattle and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the army; but he hasn’t called Solomon your servant.
verses.en_bbe: And has put to death oxen and fat beasts and sheep in great numbers, and has sent for all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab, the captain of the army; but he has not sent for Solomon your servant.

verses.en: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
verses.pt: Mas, ó rei meu senhor, os olhos de todo o Israel estão sobre ti, para que lhes declares quem há de assentar-se no teu trono depois de ti.
verses.en_web: You, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, that you should tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
verses.en_bbe: And now, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, waiting for you to say who is to take the place of my lord the king after him.

verses.en: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.
verses.pt: Doutro modo sucederá que, quando o rei meu senhor dormir com seus pais, eu e Salomão meu filho seremos tidos por ofensores.
verses.en_web: Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered criminals.”
verses.en_bbe: For as things are, it will come about, when my lord the king is sleeping with his fathers, that I and Solomon my son will be made outlaws.

verses.en: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.
verses.pt: Enquanto ela ainda falava com o rei, eis que chegou o profeta Natã.
verses.en_web: Behold, while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.
verses.en_bbe: And while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.

verses.en: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
verses.pt: E o fizeram saber ao rei, dizendo: Eis aí está o profeta Natã. Entrou Natã à presença do rei, inclinou-se perante ele com o rosto em terra,
verses.en_web: They told the king, saying, “Behold, Nathan the prophet!” When he had come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
verses.en_bbe: And they said to the king, Here is Nathan the prophet. And when he came in before the king, he went down on his face on the earth.

verses.en: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?
verses.pt: e disse: ç rei meu senhor, acaso disseste: Adonias reinará depois de mim, e se assentará no meu trono?
verses.en_web: Nathan said, “My lord, king, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne?’
verses.en_bbe: And Nathan said, O my lord king, have you said, Adonijah is to be king after me, seated on the seat of my kingdom?

verses.en: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king’s sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.
verses.pt: Pois ele hoje desceu, e matou bois, animais cevados e ovelhas em abundância, e convidou a todos os filhos do rei, e aos chefes do exército, e ao sacerdote Abiatar; e eis que comem e bebem perante ele, e dizem: Viva o rei Adonias!
verses.en_web: For he has gone down today, and has slain cattle, fatlings, and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king’s sons, the captains of the army, and Abiathar the priest. Behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and saying, ‘Long live king Adonijah!’
verses.en_bbe: Because today he has gone down and has put to death oxen and fat beasts and sheep in great numbers, and has sent for all the king's sons to come to him, with the captains of the army and Abiathar the priest; and they are feasting before him and crying, Long life to King Adonijah!

verses.en: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.
verses.pt: Porém a mim teu servo, e ao sacerdote Zadoque, e a Benaías, filho de Jeoiada, e ao teu servo Salomão, não convidou.
verses.en_web: But he hasn’t called me, even me your servant, Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon.
verses.en_bbe: But me, your servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon, he has not sent for.

verses.en: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?
verses.pt: Foi feito isso da parte do rei meu senhor? e não fizeste saber a teu servo quem havia de assentar-se no teu trono depois de ti?
verses.en_web: Was this thing done by my lord the king, and you haven’t shown to your servants who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?”
verses.en_bbe: Has this thing been done by my lord the king, without giving word to your servants who was to be placed on my lord the king's seat after him?

verses.en: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bath-sheba. And she came into the king’s presence, and stood before the king.
verses.pt: Respondeu o rei Davi: Chamai-me a Bate-Seba. E ela entrou à presença do rei, e ficou de pé diante dele.
verses.en_web: Then king David answered, “Call Bathsheba in to me.” She came into the king’s presence and stood before the king.
verses.en_bbe: Then King David in answer said, Send for Bath-sheba to come to me. And she came in and took her place before the king.

verses.en: And the king sware, and said, As the LORD liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,
verses.pt: Então o rei jurou, dizendo: Vive o Senhor, o qual remiu a minha alma de toda a angústia,
verses.en_web: The king swore, and said, “As Yahweh lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
verses.en_bbe: And the king took an oath, and said, By the living Lord, who has been my saviour from all my troubles,

verses.en: Even as I sware unto thee by the LORD God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.
verses.pt: que, assim como te jurei pelo Senhor Deus de Israel, dizendo: Teu filho Salomão há de reinar depois de mim, e ele se assentará no meu trono, em meu lugar; assim mesmo o cumprirei hoje.
verses.en_web: most certainly as I swore to you by Yahweh, the God of Israel, saying, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne in my place;’ I will most certainly do this today.”
verses.en_bbe: As I took an oath to you by the Lord, the God of Israel, saying, Certainly Solomon your son will become king after me, seated on my seat in my place; so will I do this day.

verses.en: Then Bath-sheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.
verses.pt: Então Bate-Seba, inclinando-se com o rosto em terra perante o rei, fez-lhe reverência e disse: Viva para sempre o rei Davi meu senhor!
verses.en_web: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth, and showed respect to the king, and said, “Let my lord king David live forever!”
verses.en_bbe: Then Bath-sheba went down on her face on the earth before the king giving him honour, and said, May my lord King David go on living for ever.

verses.en: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.
verses.pt: Depois disse o rei Davi: Chamai-me a Zadoque, o sacerdote, e a Natã, o profeta, e a Benaías, filho de Jeoiada. E estes entraram à presença do rei.
verses.en_web: King David said, “Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada.” They came before the king.
verses.en_bbe: And King David said, Send for Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.

verses.en: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:
verses.pt: E o rei lhes disse: Tomai convosco os servos de vosso senhor, fazei montar meu filho Salomão na minha mula, e levai-o a Giom.
verses.en_web: The king said to them, “Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon.
verses.en_bbe: And the king said to them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and put Solomon my son on my beast, yes, mine, and take him down to Gihon;

verses.en: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.
verses.pt: E Zadoque, o sacerdote, com Natã, o profeta, ali o ungirão rei sobre Israel. E tocareis a trombeta, e direis: Viva o rei Salomão!
verses.en_web: Let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel. Blow the trumpet, and say, ‘Long live king Solomon!’
verses.en_bbe: And there let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet put the holy oil on him to make him king over Israel; and sounding the horn say, Long life to King Solomon!

verses.en: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.
verses.pt: Então subireis após ele, e ele virá e se assentará no meu trono; pois reinará em meu lugar, porquanto o tenho designado para ser príncipe sobre Israel e sobre Judá.
verses.en_web: Then come up after him, and he shall come and sit on my throne; for he shall be king in my place. I have appointed him to be prince over Israel and over Judah.”
verses.en_bbe: Then come up after him and he will come in and take his place on the seat of my kingdom; for he is to be king in my place, and I have given orders that he is to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.

verses.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so too.
verses.pt: Ao que Benaías, filho de Jeoiada, respondeu ao rei, dizendo: Amém; assim o diga também o Senhor Deus do rei meu senhor.
verses.en_web: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, “Amen. May Yahweh, the God of my lord the king, say so.
verses.en_bbe: And Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, answering the king, said, So be it: and may the Lord, the God of my lord the king, say so.

verses.en: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.
verses.pt: Como o Senhor foi com o rei meu senhor, assim seja ele com Salomão, e faça que o seu trono seja maior do que o trono do rei Davi meu senhor.
verses.en_web: As Yahweh has been with my lord the king, even so may he be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.”
verses.en_bbe: As the Lord has been with my lord the king, even so may he be with Solomon and make the seat of his authority greater than that of my lord King David.

verses.en: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.
verses.pt: Pelo que desceram Zadoque, o sacerdote, e Natã, o profeta, e Benaías, filho de Jeoiada, e os quereteus, e os peleteus, e fizeram montar Salomão na mula que era do rei Davi, e o levaram a Giom.
verses.en_web: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on king David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.
verses.en_bbe: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites, went down and put Solomon on King David's beast and took him to Gihon.

verses.en: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
verses.pt: Então Zadoque, o sacerdote, tomou do tabernáculo o vaso do azeite e ungiu a Salomão. Então tocaram a trombeta, e todo o povo disse: Viva o rei Salomão!
verses.en_web: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the Tent, and anointed Solomon. They blew the trumpet; and all the people said, “Long live king Solomon!”
verses.en_bbe: And Zadok the priest took the vessel of oil out of the Tent, and put the holy oil on Solomon. And when the horn was sounded, all the people said, Long life to King Solomon!

verses.en: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.
verses.pt: E todo o povo subiu após ele, tocando flauta e alegrando-se sobremaneira, de modo que a terra retiniu com o seu clamor.
verses.en_web: All the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth shook with their sound.
verses.en_bbe: And all the people came up after him, piping with pipes, and they were glad with great joy, so that the earth was shaking with the sound.

verses.en: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?
verses.pt: Adonias e todos os convidados que estavam com ele o ouviram, ao acabarem de comer. E ouvindo Joabe o soar das trombetas, disse: Que quer dizer este alvoroço na cidade?
verses.en_web: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they had finished eating. When Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, “Why is this noise of the city being in an uproar?”
verses.en_bbe: And it came to the ears of Adonijah and all the guests who were with him, when their meal was ended. And Joab, hearing the sound of the horn, said, What is the reason of this noise as if the town was worked up?

verses.en: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.
verses.pt: Ele ainda estava falando, quando chegou Jônatas, filho de Abiatar, o sacerdote; e disse Adonias: Entra, porque és homem de bem, e trazes boas novas.
verses.en_web: While he yet spoke, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said, “Come in; for you are a worthy man, and bring good news.”
verses.en_bbe: And while the words were on his lips, Jonathan, the son of Abiathar the priest, came; and Adonijah said, Come in; for you are a man of good faith and the news which you have for us will be good.

verses.en: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.
verses.pt: Respondeu Jônatas a Adonias: Deveras! O rei Davi, nosso senhor, constituiu rei a Salomão.
verses.en_web: Jonathan answered Adonijah, “Most certainly our lord king David has made Solomon king.
verses.en_bbe: And Jonathan, answering, said to Adonijah, Not so, but our lord King David has made Solomon king:

verses.en: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king’s mule:
verses.pt: E o rei enviou com ele Zadoque, o sacerdote, e Natã, o profeta, e Benaías, filho de Jeoiada, os quereteus e os peleteus; e eles o fizeram montar na mula do rei.
verses.en_web: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride on the king’s mule.
verses.en_bbe: And he sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they put him on the king's beast:

verses.en: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.
verses.pt: E Zadoque, o sacerdote, e Natã, o profeta, ungiram-no rei em Giom; e dali subiram cheios de alegria, e a cidade está alvoroçada. Este é o clamor que ouvistes.
verses.en_web: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon. They have come up from there rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.
verses.en_bbe: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet put the holy oil on him and made him king in Gihon; and they came back from there with joy, and the town was all worked up. This is the noise which has come to your ears.

verses.en: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.
verses.pt: E Salomão já está assentado no trono do reino.
verses.en_web: Also, Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.
verses.en_bbe: And now Solomon is seated on the seat of the kingdom.

verses.en: And moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.
verses.pt: Além disso os servos do rei vieram abençoar o nosso senhor, o rei Davi, dizendo: Faça teu Deus o nome de Salomão mais célebre do que o teu nome, e faça o seu trono maior do que o teu trono. E o rei se inclinou no leito.
verses.en_web: Moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne;’ and the king bowed himself on the bed.
verses.en_bbe: And the king's servants came to our lord King David, blessing him and saying, May God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and the seat of his authority greater than your seat; and the king was bent low in worship on his bed.

verses.en: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.
verses.pt: Também assim falou o rei: Bendito o Senhor Deus de Israel, que hoje tem dado quem se assente no meu trono, e que os meus olhos o vissem.
verses.en_web: Also thus said the king, ‘Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne today, my eyes even seeing it.’”
verses.en_bbe: Then the king said, May the God of Israel be praised, who has given one of my seed to be king in my place this day and has let my eyes see it.

verses.en: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.
verses.pt: Então, tomados de pavor, levantaram-se todos os convidados que estavam com Adonias, e cada qual se foi seu caminho.
verses.en_web: All the guests of Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and each man went his way.
verses.en_bbe: And all the guests of Adonijah got up in fear and went away, every man to his place.

verses.en: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.pt: Adonias, porém, temeu a Salomão e, levantando-se, foi apegar-se às pontas do altar.
verses.en_web: Adonijah was afraid because of Solomon; and he arose, and went, and hung onto the horns of the altar.
verses.en_bbe: And Adonijah himself was full of fear because of Solomon; and he got up and went to the altar, and put his hands on its horns.

verses.en: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.
verses.pt: E foi dito a Salomão: Eis que Adonias teme ao rei Salomão; pois que se apegou às pontas do altar, dizendo: Jure-me hoje o rei Salomão que não matará o seu servo à espada.
verses.en_web: Solomon was told, “Behold, Adonijah fears king Solomon; for, behold, he is hanging onto the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let king Solomon swear to me first that he will not kill his servant with the sword.’”
verses.en_bbe: And they gave Solomon word of it, saying, See, Adonijah goes in such fear of King Solomon, that he has put his hands on the horns of the altar, saying, Let King Solomon first give me his oath that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.

verses.en: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.
verses.pt: Ao que disse Salomão: Se ele se houver como homem de bem, nem um só de seus cabelos cairá em terra; se, porém, se houver dolosamente, morrerá.
verses.en_web: Solomon said, “If he shows himself a worthy man, not a hair of his shall fall to the earth; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die.”
verses.en_bbe: And Solomon said, If he is seen to be a man of good faith, not a hair of him will be touched; but if any wrongdoing is seen in him, he is to be put to death.

verses.en: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.
verses.pt: Então o rei Salomão deu ordem, e tiraram Adonias do altar. E vindo ele, inclinou-se perante o rei Salomão, o qual lhe disse: Vai para tua casa.
verses.en_web: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. He came and bowed down to king Solomon; and Solomon said to him, “Go to your house.”
verses.en_bbe: So King Solomon sent, and they took him down from the altar. And he came and gave honour to King Solomon; and Solomon said to him, Go to your house.
